characters.earlierSummary: The Void is Bob Reynolds' destructive alter ego, embodying his depression and insecurities. It was released when Mel triggered Sentry's kill switch. It engulfed New York in darkness, turned people into shadows and trapped them in pocket dimensions built from their worst memories, until the Thunderbolts' belief in Bob let him regain control.

characters.earlierSummary: An immortal Eternal who transmutes the matter she touches, turning a bus into rose petals, pavement into sand and a tree into water. She was thought unable to change sentient beings until she turned a Deviant into a tree. Through the Uni-Mind she turned the Celestial Tiamut to stone and stopped the Emergence.
